faq.q: What is a titanium reactor lining plate?
faq.a: A titanium reactor lining plate is a precision-machined reactor hardware component used in explosion-bonded pta reactor lining plate (gr 7 clad). Manufactured from Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium reactor lining plate?
faq.a: Titanium Reactor Lining Plate is designed for explosion-bonded pta reactor lining plate (gr 7 clad). The Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium reactor lining plate manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Reactor Lining Plate is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium reactor lining plate?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium reactor lining plate?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
